data.text:
POSSIBLE INTERVENTIONS TO MANAGE MARCOS HIGHWAY TRAFFIC

WATCH: Victor Nuñez, MMDA Traffic Enforcement Group director, says traffic on Marcos Highway would be better managed through adjustments in U-turn slots, harmonization of truck ban hours, and deployment of more traffic enforcers.

Authorities are rushing to implement measures to improve traffic flow in Metro Manila in the Christmas season and avoid a repeat of the "carmageddon" on Marcos Highway on Dec. 6.

The MMDA and the local government units of Pasig, Marikina, Cainta, and Antipolo will inspect Marcos Highway traffic movement and interventions on Wednesday, Dec. 9.

Informal settlers and urban poor groups stage “Panunuluyan 2025,” a Christmas-themed protest, at the National Housing Authority in Quezon City on Tuesday, December 9, highlighting the lack of shelter and displacement in urban poor communities. Photos by Jire Carreon/Rappler https://t.co/6cCGev6twB
